title: Machete and Explosives Attack at Torreón Secondary School Kills Vice Principal
detail: On October 1, two 18-year-old twin brothers, former students of Secondary School No. 13 in Ejido La Unión, Torreón, Coahuila, attacked the school with machetes and rudimentary explosives, killing a vice principal and injuring four people (two teachers, a student and a bystander). At her October 2 press conference Sheinbaum announced a working group to demand that social media platforms remove content promoting violence, abuse or harassment; Security Minister Omar García Harfuch said a decree setting platform obligations would follow the next week. Single-outlet report; casualty details may be revised.

media.caption: Sheinbaum targets violent social media content after Torreón school attack

title: Sheinbaum Marks Two Years in Office, Touting Approval Ratings of Up to 75%
detail: On October 1, the second anniversary of her inauguration, Sheinbaum cited approval ratings of up to 75% at her morning press conference and highlighted women-focused policies, including a pension for women aged 60 to 64, constitutional enshrinement of women's rights and a new anti-femicide law. The figures are the government's own citation of polls.

media.caption: Two years in, Sheinbaum touts approval ratings of up to 75%
